Annual log growth on the 108 test months is 12.31%. CAGR on the same path is 13.10%. That CAGR is the graded annualized return. The combined January 2000–December 2018 path keeps the 2008 drawdown, −49.51%.

## How the books invest

Equal weight holds every name at the same weight and stays fully invested.

Top 10 positive-vol and full baskets invest only in positive one-month momentum. One month is the last return already earned. Weight is proportional to that return. The rest is cash, and cash earns nothing.

Each month, five K-means groups are fit on the trailing 12-month return path. A group that was not up gets no capital. Inside a group that was up, only members that were up are held.

Top 10 first keeps, in each group, the ten names with the largest positive volatility, then applies that rule. Full baskets skip that cut.

```{python}

```

Top-10 positive-vol has higher annual log growth than equal weight on the official test, and a lower Sharpe. Full baskets land below equal weight.

## The forecast

::: {.incremental}
- Four factory classifiers, plus K nearest neighbors on return quintiles.
- Downside multiplies a held weight by (1 − 0.5 × P(down)) and leaves the cut in cash. Upside boosts a held name by 50% when P(up) is at least 0.60, then returns to the original stock budget.
- Loss probabilities do not beat the historical loss rate. Quintile accuracy is about 22.6% against a 20% guess. The KNN book equal-weights its predicted top quintile.
- A ten-factor cut moves the training books by about 0.2 percentage point.
- GridSearchCV on log loss barely moves the equal-weight holdout book.
:::
